Reference-data uploads of the wizard's Upload Data step

Source: R/wizard-reference_estimates.R
reference_estimates_ui.Rd

Optional upload zones for the reference estimates the analysis uses: UN estimates, WUENIC estimates and UN mortality estimates, each a Stata file (.dta). Which zones show is set by the app (cd_wizard_config()$reference_uploads). The dataset uses built-in estimates for its country until the user uploads a file. An uploaded file is read for the dataset's country and saved with cache()$set_un_estimates(), cache()$set_wuenic_estimates() or cache()$set_un_mortality_estimates(). A zone's reset button goes back to the built-in estimates (cache()$clear_un_estimates() and so on). A file that cannot be read shows an error banner under its zone. These uploads do not affect whether the Upload Data step counts as complete.

Usage

reference_estimates_ui(id, i18n)

reference_estimates_server(id, cache, i18n)

Arguments

id

The module's id.

i18n

The app's translator (a shiny.i18n translator), used for every label.

cache

A reactive that returns the dataset, a CacheConnection.

Value

reference_estimates_ui() returns the UI as Shiny tags: a divider and a group of upload zones. reference_estimates_server() is called for its side effects and returns nothing useful.

Details

The UI has no card of its own: it is a divided section meant to sit in the same card as upload_box_ui(). UN estimates are read for the years of the dataset (cache()$data_years), so that zone does nothing until the dataset has years.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# in the server of the Load Data screen: the Upload Data step's page is one card
# holding the dataset's upload zone and these reference-data zones
panel <- list(key = "upload", ui = cd_card(
  title = i18n$t("title_upload_dataset_card"), width = 12,
  upload_box_ui(ns("upload_box"), i18n),
  reference_estimates_ui(ns("reference_estimates"), i18n)
))
reference_estimates_server("reference_estimates", cache, i18n)
} # }
